convergence.exportInvocation: pen interactive --in <file.pen> --out <tmp.pen>; execute({ input: 'Export(["<frameId>", ...], "png", "<dir>")' }) — default scale 2; the .pen MUST sit at its committed lane path so the relative library import (../../../design-system/in-progress/hemlock-library.lib.pen), the fonts (../../fonts/) and the ./GC-018-deck-assets/ image fills resolve. Re-export verified byte-deterministic across consecutive runs (all 26 frames hash-identical, all 26 distinct).
convergence.comparison: pixelmatch threshold 0.1 (harness convention), per-state budget 1.0% (dispatch default; states.json pixelThreshold 0.03 is the Gate-1 story-vs-pen budget, not this loop's). Targets = NORMALIZED prototype, per-state contract roots (#dkA / .dk-lb / .dk-vm .sc-modal), Chromium via playwright 1.49 headless, deviceScaleFactor 2, viewport 1280x1400 (contract storyViewport). Protocol: Google Fonts origins blocked + @font-face injection serving Heebo/Noto Serif from the SAME repo TTFs the .pen references (pencil/designs/fonts/); --font-render-hinting=none --disable-font-subpixel-positioning --disable-lcd-text; transitions/animations frozen, caret hidden; fresh context per state; pointer parked at 0,0 after steps (no GC-018 state is a hover state); videos paused at frame 0 (the modal WebM autoplays natively — the contract banks paused + controls visible); INTEGER-CSS-PIXEL root snap before capture (Playwright element screenshots clip at integer CSS px — a fractional root origin shifts every target by one device px; snap verified round 3); double-screenshot self-consistency gate; L3a settle >=1000ms + textProbes + cross-state PNG distinctness before every bank.
iterationNotes: R1 (16/26): geometry+type converged at first export — failures were photograph resampling (pen scaler vs Chromium), the modal root shadow inflating export bounds, missing UA list markers (config-error), and a systematic 1-device-px target shift.

R2 (17/26): photographs re-banked as Chromium-rendered region rasters (element-region screenshots with scrim/caption/play/footer overlays suppressed — GC-015 assets precedent); video well banked as paused-frame raster; root frame exports shadow-free; ::marker synthesis added.

R3 (26/26): root cause of the residual shift found — Playwright element screenshots clip at INTEGER CSS pixels; contract roots snapped to that grid in both target and transcription flows; frame dims ceil to integer CSS.

R4 (26/26, final): stroke-only paths dropped inline transparent fills (Iron-Law hygiene); active progress dot re-bound from sem-btnPrimaryBg to the carousel active-dot role ($sem-carouselDotActive, GC-015 precedent). Worst state 0.452% (body-two-column); median 0.2%.
convergence.geometryProbesRun: contract-named vectors verified against the extracted scenes (the direct geometry source of the frames): V2 auto-sizing (600x337.5 / 500x647.05 / 704x528, radius 2), V1/V2 canvas scales (.46875 / .612745 / .666667), V3 caret rail (40x40 at left 604/504, top 174.75/329.52), 68px peek gap, menu min-width 230 + radius 6, V6 expanded fit (holder 1280x720 at y340, canvas scale 1.0), modal 640 + 16:9 well, V11 split media columns (563.2 / 491.2 design px), stats hairline split (landscape LEFT / portrait TOP) — all pass.

interactive icon role. Bill's dark caret is WHITE, not the token's blue-400 — an authored dark decision the uncontracted-dark re-oracle must reconcile; recorded here so it is not lost.
a filled primary-action chip; the white ring on a colored face is exactly the focus-inverted border role.
error roles; token-true divergences #B91C1C→#C82320 and #FEE2E2→#FFEAEA (the kit's material-red set moves to Hemlock's).
kit text-1 is the header-ink role (GC-013 precedent); tabular ordinals are action text; the check is an interactive icon.

tokenJudgmentCalls.surface: page float shadow / menu shadow / modal shadow
tokenJudgmentCalls.boundToken: $sem-deckPageShadow (NEW — outside the ramp: zero offset, diffuse) / shadow-md trio (token-true .12→.10) / shadow-overlay trio (exact)
tokenJudgmentCalls.rationale: the elevation ramp owns the menu and modal; the page float shadow has no ramp role (no y-offset, warm tint, dark value is the template's glow blue) — created, gap-recorded.

tokenJudgmentCalls.surface: photograph regions (cafe/booth/trees artwork, poster tile, split/full-bleed media)
tokenJudgmentCalls.prototypeValue: embedded JPEG data URIs, object-fit cover crops
tokenJudgmentCalls.rationale: photographs are not tokenizable (skill-sanctioned raster exception). Each occurrence is banked as the Chromium-rendered crop (element-region screenshot with scrim/caption/play/footer overlays suppressed) so the pen blit is scaler-neutral — the GC-015 assets precedent. Scrims, captions, play marks and chips REMAIN vector, token-bound, composited above the rasters.

tokenJudgmentCalls.prototypeValue: autoplaying 5s WebM (no poster attr) + native Chromium controls
tokenJudgmentCalls.rationale: playing pixels are frame-nondeterministic per the contract; the banked composition is the player PAUSED at frame 0 with controls visible (exactly what the land story must mount). Native controls are shadow-DOM chrome — raster is the only faithful representation.
the contract-root screenshot cannot contain its own outside shadow; a frame-level effect inflates the export canvas and breaks the pixel join. Role recorded in the recipe (shadow-overlay trio).
pen has no dash/dot stroke; at sub-pixel scale the dotted line rasterizes as a soft gray run — a solid hairline at half opacity is perceptually equivalent (verified within the per-state budget).

tokenJudgmentCalls.boundToken: synthesized • text runs, same fill role as the list text ($y:sem-text-error)
tokenJudgmentCalls.rationale: markers are not DOM; synthesized at the Blink outside-marker gap (~0.575em) aligned to the first text line.

tokenJudgmentCalls.prototypeValue: design-canvas sizes (52/44 title, 30/26 h2, 120/96 ghost, 64/54 stat …) rendered at displayScale (.46875/.612745/.666667/1.0)
tokenJudgmentCalls.boundToken: literal rendered sizes (designSize x scale) on the text nodes; families bound $y:font-primary/$y:font-secondary; line placement via $line-height-solid + measured line boxes
tokenJudgmentCalls.rationale: the design-canvas law scales page type visually; tokens cannot express the scale transform. The unscaled design ramp is recorded as a typography design gap for the designer; chrome text (unscaled) binds scale tokens ($y:text-size-sm/-xs/-2xs).
